_note: Archetypes describe the buying behaviour typical of a kind of buyer in India. Example firms are reference points only; agents never speak as those firms or claim their views.

archetypes.label: Institutional logistics/warehousing park developer
archetypes.reference_points: IndoSpace, ESR, Welspun One, Horizon Industrial Parks type
archetypes.horizon: builds and leases Grade-A sheds, holds 7-10 years or sells to a REIT/fund
objections: location not yet proven for warehousing demand
archetypes.price_posture: pays raw-land value plus a little for approvals; discounts heavily for title or approval risk

archetypes.label: Large listed integrated industrial township developer
archetypes.horizon: multi-decade cluster development with anchor tenants
objections: site too small for a township
archetypes.price_posture: prefers JDA or partnership; rarely pays a premium for small parcels

archetypes.label: Regional residential developer diversifying into industrial/logistics
archetypes.horizon: develop plots and sell within 3-5 years
archetypes.price_posture: prefers JDA with revenue share; outright only at a discount

archetypes.label: 3PL / logistics operator with assured volumes (end user)
archetypes.reference_points: regional 3PL or transport company serving a large plant
archetypes.horizon: own use, wants to be operational fast
priorities: proximity to the anchor plant or port
objections: price above alternatives near the plant
archetypes.price_posture: pays near developed-plot value if it can start building quickly

archetypes.label: Steel ancillary / fabrication unit (end user)
archetypes.reference_points: vendors following a large integrated steel plant
archetypes.horizon: own use; timing tied to the anchor plant's construction
archetypes.price_posture: benchmarks against APIIC allotment rates and nearby private parks

archetypes.label: Pharma / API manufacturer (end user)
archetypes.reference_points: mid-size bulk drug or formulation unit
objections: Bulk Drug Park offers subsidies instead
archetypes.price_posture: compares with subsidised bulk-drug-park allotments; pays more only for speed

archetypes.label: Small MSME manufacturer
objections: bank will not lend until infrastructure is complete
archetypes.price_posture: price-sensitive; pays per sq yd and compares closely with nearby layouts

archetypes.label: Real-estate private equity fund / AIF
archetypes.horizon: 3-6 year exit at a target IRR of 18-25%
objections: target IRR not met at asking price
archetypes.price_posture: back-solves price from target IRR; demands downside protection

archetypes.label: Family office / HNI investor
archetypes.reference_points: regional business family diversifying into land
archetypes.horizon: holds 3-7 years for appreciation or lease income
archetypes.price_posture: negotiates hard; will pay for a strong corridor story

archetypes.label: NRI investor
archetypes.reference_points: non-resident Indian with roots in the region
archetypes.horizon: long hold; often relies on family locally
objections: cannot buy agricultural land under FEMA
archetypes.price_posture: willing to pay retail plot prices for convenience and trust

archetypes.label: Local land investor / speculator
archetypes.reference_points: local investor who buys ahead of infrastructure
archetypes.price_posture: wants a discount to current market; pays cash quickly

archetypes.label: Cold-chain / food or aqua processing unit
archetypes.price_posture: moderate; values power and port access

archetypes.label: Solar / renewable developer (land lease)
priorities: land unsuitable for building (buffers, CRZ residual)
archetypes.price_posture: pays only annual rent; useful for land that cannot be built on

archetypes.label: Port-linked EXIM / container freight station operator
archetypes.reference_points: CFS or ICD operator near a major port
archetypes.price_posture: pays well for the right location, walks away otherwise

archetypes.label: Industrial REIT / InvIT
archetypes.reference_points: listed or private trust buying income-producing assets
archetypes.price_posture: does not buy raw land; may sign a forward purchase once leased
